overview: You set twenty-nine beside last Saturday's thirty-three. You wrote that the coffer was not opened, and that it stands as ruled at twenty pound fifteen. You did not make a new sum.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the share, and did not open the coffer.

parties.name: John Heminges
parties.context: Put the shilling on the line. The leaf is yours.

parties.name: Will Kemp
parties.context: Paid the share with the name. Not in the house.
